svg.text: A reference names a logical page, never a place
history file: preallocated, equal 8 KiB slots
A packed page of small records occupies one slot, at
diskPoolBase + slot × 8192. A record that does not fit in one block
gets a dedicated logical page whose blocks need not be adjacent;
a 100,000-byte value needs about thirteen blocks, read in parallel.
Spilling moves a page; no reference changes
Only the table row is rewritten. Every stored HistoryRef to page 41
still resolves, with the same offset and length.
A reused slot gets a new generation
A delayed read that expected generation 3 finds 4, discards its
buffer and returns transaction_too_old. Holes left by reclamation
are reused by any later page: no external fragmentation.
